title: SprintPipelineReturnSchema
description: Top-level return of sprint_pipeline.js. The per-story results the calling skill iterates ride under `stories`; the run's stage timings ride alongside them under `_telemetry`, whose leading underscore marks it out-of-band so consumers iterating story results skip it.

stories.description: One SprintStoryReturn per completed (or blocked / failed / infrastructure-failed) story. This is the array the calling skill iterates to persist results.

_telemetry.description: Stage timings collected by the pipeline's timer — one interval per agent() call the run made, including calls that returned null or threw. Out-of-band: the reporting layer renders it; consumers iterating story results ignore it.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 wall-clock instant the stage began, from Date, so intervals from concurrent stories compose onto one timeline.

endedAt.description: ISO-8601 wall-clock instant the stage ended, stamped in a finally so success, null-return, and throw each record exactly one interval.
